etsy.title: HTTP Status Codes Poster, 200 400 500 Backend Joke, API Developer Wall Art, Web Dev Coworker Gift
etsy.description:
A funny HTTP status codes poster that explains them the honest way: 200 OK, 400 your fault, 500 my fault.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• A physical poster print, shipped directly to you
• Available in 8×10 in or 11×17 in
• Printed on premium matte paper at 300 DPI

HOW TO USE
Frame and hang for a home office, dev den, or coding setup.

This listing is a physical poster print. Thank you for supporting a small shop!

competitorNotes: Etsy HTTP status code posters are serious REST API reference charts sold as digital downloads (about GBP 5-8).
A 418 teapot shirt is the main joke item; a three-code joke print parodies the reference charts.
Amazon has no HTTP status code posters; only a 403 Forbidden novelty shirt surfaced.
Amazon programmer prints lead with the joke, then stack 'wall art', 'office decor', 'developer gift' and state 'unframed' plus size.

research.notes: 'HTTP Status Codes Poster' is the exact phrase competing reference listings use; the snippet did not expose that listing's URL. Listing pages were not reachable from this environment; evidence is from search results only. No priceRange: snippets mixed digital downloads with framed prints, and no unframed physical prints with prices were comparable.
